effect.plerocottage.rosa_hedge.descripti: Negates a single hit dealing no more than 2 + 0.25 × level damage.
effect.plerocottage.dark_wrath.descripti: Increases melee damage by 50% + 5% × level and reduces damage from creature attacks by the same amount. Ends after killing a creature.
effect.plerocottage.ice_barrier.descript: Greatly reduces damage from non-creature melee attacks; a single hit meeting the threshold or any fire damage consumes the effect.
effect.plerocottage.cherry_blossoms_weep: Increases attack knockback and may scatter cherry petals.
effect.plerocottage.hacked_thorns.descri: Grants projectile immunity; melee attackers are knocked back and take reflected damage based on your armor.
effect.plerocottage.poison_heal_medicine: Immunizes you to magic damage and heals for 70% + 5% × level of the damage.
effect.plerocottage.kiwing_whereabouts.d: Being attacked by a creature briefly grants invisibility, speed, and invulnerability; also reduces fall damage.
effect.plerocottage.purity.description: Instantly removes all harmful effects and restores 45% + 2.5% × level of missing health.
effect.plerocottage.momentary_meteor.des: Your next melee attack deals 5 + 0.15 × level times its damage.
effect.plerocottage.snow_veil.descriptio: Reduces damage from creature melee attacks, with weaker mitigation in hot environments. Fire damage consumes the effect.
effect.plerocottage.aurora_veil.descript: Greatly reduces all incoming damage; fire damage consumes the effect.
effect.plerocottage.tipsy.description: Reduces movement speed and increases attack damage.
effect.plerocottage.lurking_danger.descr: Crouching for a while grants stealth, invisibility, and increased movement speed; standing grants brief Strength.
effect.plerocottage.inner_focus.descript: Reduces maximum health while increasing attack damage, movement and swim speed, and attack knockback.
effect.plerocottage.summer_heatwave.desc: Increases movement speed by 2% and swim speed by 4% per level.
effect.plerocottage.melon_gravity.descri: Adds 0.08 knockback resistance and 0.15 blocks of step height per level.
effect.plerocottage.gem_excavation.descr: Reveals nearby ore blocks within a range that increases with the effect level.
effect.plerocottage.fragrant.description: Instantly restores 60% + 2.5% × level of missing health.
effect.plerocottage.menthol_awakening.de: Increases the level of your other beneficial effects, including those gained while active, by 1, up to level 256.
effect.plerocottage.rutin_lemonene.descr: Grants bonus experience equal to 80% + 5% × level of the base experience dropped by a slain creature.
effect.plerocottage.happy_aura.descripti: Melee attacks deal 70% + 5% × level of their damage to nearby creatures, excluding tamed creatures and those with this effect.
effect.plerocottage.bursting_berry.descr: Critical hits deal 50% + 5% × level more damage and set the target's armor to zero for 3 seconds. Another critical hit resets the timer.
effect.plerocottage.original_evolution.d: Killing a creature extends each non-fruit beneficial effect by 15 + 0.2 × level seconds, up to 60 minutes.
effect.plerocottage.sea_touch.descriptio: Increases block and entity interaction reach.
effect.plerocottage.wallnut_first_aid.de: Grants absorption equal to 60% + 15% × level of your maximum health.
effect.plerocottage.transmutation_elixir: Every third melee hit on a target deals extra magic damage equal to 35% + 5% × level of its current health, up to 85%.
effect.plerocottage.flatten.description: Halves model and hitbox height, increases width and depth to 130%, reduces attack damage attribute by 50%, and reduces movement speed by 30%.
